text: Ambra Anton If you converted in Israel, you generally aren't eligible for the Sal Klita and other Aliyah benefits. This is because the benefits for Olim aren't available to people who have lived in Israel for 24 months in the 3 years before making Aliyah. The time it takes to get the necessary visa to convert, the conversion process itself, and the processing of the Aliyah applications is almost always longer than 24 months. This applies to both official (Rabbinate) and private/Reform/Masorti conversions.
